claims.evidence: Witness only reports it is a mountain bike with front suspension, disc brake rotor visible, and drivetrain appears intact from the angle shown; no durability test or structural inspection evidence.
Witness notes no close-up of brand/model and does not show brake pad/rotor wear, tyre tread/cracks, wheel/bearing play, frame cracks/dents/rust, or gear shifting performance.

risks.risk: Brake condition may be poor even if a disc rotor is visible (pads worn, rotor warped, caliper issues).
risks.proof: A close-up video/photo of both brake calipers and pads (showing pad thickness) plus a short clip braking from a slow roll.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used mountain bike with brakes not guaranteed (assume possible brake service needed).

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn, cracked, or bulged despite knobby tread appearance.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of both tyres (sidewalls and tread) showing any cracks, bulges, and tread depth.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres may need replacement soon.

risks.risk: Wheel alignment and bearing health may be bad (front/rear play, wobble).
risks.proof: A clip showing the bike lifted and wheels spun, plus a side-to-side wobble check at the front fork and rear axle.

risks.risk: Frame may have hidden damage (dents/cracks/rust at joints) not visible in the outdoor angle.
risks.proof: Photos of the full frame from multiple angles, especially around the head tube, bottom bracket, seat stays, and rear rack mounts; include a close-up of any rust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing frame inspection/repair if issues are found.

risks.risk: Drivetrain may have wear (chain stretch, cassette/sprocket wear) or shifting may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of shifting through all gears under pedaling load, plus a close-up of chain and cassette/sprockets.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming drivetrain may need cleaning/lubrication and possible parts replacement.

risks.risk: Accessories/functionality may be missing or non-working (lights, bell, lock, pump, kickstand).
risks.proof: A photo list showing included accessories and a short clip demonstrating lights/bell/kickstand if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming any extra accessories are included or working.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of brake pads and the rotor on both sides (and any brake lever/cable condition).
Send tyre close-ups (tread and sidewalls) showing cracks/bulges and approximate tread depth.
Send a short video: wheel spin test and wobble check at front fork and rear axle.
Send full frame photos from multiple angles, focusing on head tube, bottom bracket, and rear rack mounting points.
Send a video of shifting through all gears while pedaling, plus close-ups of chain and cassette/sprockets.
Confirm what accessories are included and show them (lights working, bell, lock/pump/kickstand if any).
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a mountain bike with front suspension and disc brake rotor visible, which is enough to price at a worst-case used condition. However, multiple key condition checks (brakes, tyres, bearings, frame integrity, shifting) are not shown, so it should be priced conservatively until proof is provided.
